'''Mira''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was assigned to [[Carrick Station]], where she sold powerful relics and armor to the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
